topic: 限时听力：学术独白与阶段测评
grammarFocus: 学术句子的主干、修饰关系与名词短语；被动表达。
title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Academic Monologue Recording and Staged Assessment Process
prompt: The diagram below shows the process by which a university language centre produces a recorded academic monologue and then uses it for a staged listening assessment. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先花约2分钟读图，确认流程的起点、终点以及各阶段之间的先后关系。写作时先写一句改写题目的概述，再总体说明流程包含几个主要阶段；主体段落按时间顺序描述关键步骤，并比较不同阶段在参与人员、所用时间或产出物上的差异。注意使用恰当的被动语态和顺序连接词，不要加入个人观点或解释原因。全文不少于150词，写完后检查是否覆盖了图中所有主要步骤。

figure.title: Production and Staged Assessment of a Recorded Academic Monologue
steps: A subject lecturer drafts a 12-minute academic monologue script on a chosen topic.
A language tutor reviews the script and marks difficult vocabulary and complex sentence structures.
The lecturer records the monologue in the studio; the first recording takes 25 minutes.
A technician edits the audio, removing pauses and adding section markers every 3 minutes.
The edited recording is uploaded to the listening practice platform for student access.
Students complete a first listening task at home and submit their answers online.
Tutors mark the answers and identify the three most frequently missed sections.
In class, the lecturer replays those sections and leads a 20-minute discussion of listening strategies.
